CURIO Settings & Hub
🗂️ 1. Multi-Catalog System

Use the Active Catalog dropdown in the top-left sidebar to switch between 15 pre-loaded encyclopedias (Games, Creative Software, OS histories, Anime eras, Biology, Mythologies). Click ＋ to build your own custom library.

🎛️ 2. Five Dynamic Views

Switch views in the top-right bar anytime:
• Grid: Standard card gallery with radiant monograms.
• Detailed: Expanded two-column layout with multi-photo rails.
• List: Dense spreadsheet table for rapid comparison.
• Kanban: Interactive workflow columns (To Explore ➔ Curated).
• Grouped: Collapsible accordion sections grouped by Drawer, Status, Rating, or Alphabetical.

⚡ 3. Spotlight Command Palette (Ctrl+K)

Press Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K on Mac) from anywhere to search across all 15 catalogs simultaneously. Press Enter on any item to instantly switch catalogs and jump straight to the card with a glowing pulse.

⭐ 4. Pinning & 1-Click Markdown Copy

• Click ⭐ on any card to pin top tools to the head of your list.
• Click 📋 to instantly copy formatted Markdown ([Title](link) - Notes) to paste directly into Obsidian, Notion, or code comments.

💾 5. Gigabyte Offline Storage & ZIP Backup

All data is stored inside your local IndexedDB. Click Export in the sidebar to download a complete .zip package with your database JSON and real extracted image files.
